podcast.title: Drummer for The Bangles and Collaborator
podcast.body: Debbie Peterson was the drummer for The Bangles, a band that transitioned from the alternative Paisley Underground scene to a hugely successful Top 40 act. After The Bangles' breakup, she went on to play with notable artists like Cindy Lauper, Tom Petty, and Elvis Costello. "Their drummer was Debbie Peterson. Since The Bangles break up, Debbie has played with Cindy Lopper and Tom Petty and Elvis Costello, just to name a few."
